comment:
* super class for all Password Based Encryption (PBE) parameter generator classes.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public void init(byte[] password, byte[] salt, int iterationCount)
methods.comment:
* initialise the PBE generator.
     *
     * @param password the password converted into bytes (see below).
     * @param salt the salt to be mixed with the password.
     * @param iterationCount the number of iterations the "mixing" function
     * is to be applied for.

methods.name: public byte[] getPassword()
methods.comment:
* return the password byte array.
     *
     * @return the password byte array.

methods.name: public byte[] getSalt()
methods.comment:
* return the salt byte array.
     *
     * @return the salt byte array.

methods.name: public int getIterationCount()
methods.comment:
* return the iteration count.
     *
     * @return the iteration count.

methods.name: public abstract CipherParameters generateDerivedParameters(int keySize)
methods.comment:
* generate derived parameters for a key of length keySize.
     *
     * @param keySize the length, in bits, of the key required.
     * @return a parameters object representing a key.

methods.name: public abstract CipherParameters generateDerivedParameters(int keySize, int ivSize)
methods.comment:
* generate derived parameters for a key of length keySize, and
     * an initialisation vector (IV) of length ivSize.
     *
     * @param keySize the length, in bits, of the key required.
     * @param ivSize the length, in bits, of the iv required.
     * @return a parameters object representing a key and an IV.

methods.name: public abstract CipherParameters generateDerivedMacParameters(int keySize)
methods.comment:
* generate derived parameters for a key of length keySize, specifically
     * for use with a MAC.
     *
     * @param keySize the length, in bits, of the key required.
     * @return a parameters object representing a key.

methods.name: public static byte[] PKCS5PasswordToBytes(char[] password)
methods.comment:
* converts a password to a byte array according to the scheme in
     * PKCS5 (ascii, no padding)
     *
     * @param password a character array representing the password.
     * @return a byte array representing the password.

methods.name: public static byte[] PKCS5PasswordToUTF8Bytes(char[] password)
methods.comment:
* converts a password to a byte array according to the scheme in
     * PKCS5 (UTF-8, no padding)
     *
     * @param password a character array representing the password.
     * @return a byte array representing the password.

methods.name: public static byte[] PKCS12PasswordToBytes(char[] password)
methods.comment:
* converts a password to a byte array according to the scheme in
     * PKCS12 (unicode, big endian, 2 zero pad bytes at the end).
     *
     * @param password a character array representing the password.
     * @return a byte array representing the password.

methodNames: public void init(byte[] password, byte[] salt, int iterationCount)
public abstract CipherParameters generateDerivedParameters(int keySize, int ivSize)
